name: cipherhub
description: Production-grade cryptography toolkit exposing 55 cryptographic operations via MCP. Covers classical algorithms (AES CBC/GCM/CTR/XTS, ChaCha20-Poly1305, RSA, ECC, SHA-2, SHAKE), Chinese national standards (SM2, SM3, SM4, ZUC, SM9 identity-based cryptography), post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM FIPS 203, ML-DSA FIPS 204, X25519+ML-KEM-768 hybrid KEX), X.509 certificate handling, and structured crypto messages (CMS, COSE, CBOR, ASN.1/DER). Interoperability verified against AWS KMS (70/70), Tencent Cloud KMS (39/39), and OpenSSL 3.6 (148/154).
